title.narrative: Improved sanitaton for people and the environment in Costa Rica

description.narrative: The general objective is to improve the environmental conditions and create positive impacts on public health. Pollution of water resources and water related health risks will be reduced. This will be achieved by the replacement, expansion and new construction of urban wastewater infrastructure as well as its economically and ecologically sustainable use and management of this infrastructure.
